name: Section break
summary: Use a GOV.UK section break on an hr element to create a thematic break with standard spacing and an optional visible rule.
rules: Use an hr element with govuk-section-break when the content has a genuine thematic break.
Select govuk-section-break--m, --l or --xl for the required standard margin.
Add govuk-section-break--visible only when users need a visible separator; the default break is represented by spacing alone.
accessibility: Use the native hr semantic only for a thematic change, not as decoration.
Do not rely on the separator line as the only cue that a new subject or task begins.
restrictions: Do not use empty div elements, repeated hyphens or CSS borders as substitutes for the documented section-break contract.
